faq.question: When calculating final scores, what three things can give me points: birds, eggs, and tucked birds?
faq.answer: Yes. Your final score comes from points earned on birds you've played, eggs on those birds, and any bird cards you've tucked under other birds during the game.
faq.source_quote: The winner is the player with the most points accumulated from birds, and tucked birds.

faq.question: What exactly do I place next to the bird tray during setup?
faq.answer: Place the deck next to the bird tray, then populate the tray with 3 face-up bird cards.
faq.source_quote: Place it next to the bird tray, then populate the tray with 3 face-up bird cards.

faq.question: When deciding which food tokens to keep, how much weight should I give to what the bird cards show?
faq.answer: When deciding which food tokens to keep, consider the food types shown in the upper left of the bird cards you selected. This will help you plan which birds you can afford to play.
faq.source_quote: You will probably want to keep food tokens shown in the upper left of the bird cards you selected.

faq.question: Can I look at my bonus cards while I'm deciding which birds to keep?
faq.answer: Yes. You may look at your bonus cards at any time while selecting which birds to keep, and you may look at your bird cards while selecting which bonus card to keep.
faq.source_quote: You may look at your bonus cards while selecting which birds to keep (and vice versa).

faq.question: What should I consider before playing a bird from my hand?
faq.answer: Before choosing to play a bird from your hand, consider its habitat, food requirements, and egg cost.
faq.source_quote: Play a Bird From Your Hand Before choosing to play a bird from your hand, consider its habitat, food habitat requirements, and egg cost.

faq.question: When can I use a card-to-food bonus conversion—do I have to use it right away when I place my action cube?
faq.answer: Yes, you must use it immediately when placing your cube. If the slot shows a card-to-food bonus conversion, you may immediately discard at most 1 bird card from your hand to gain an additional food token from the remaining dice in the birdfeeder.
faq.source_quote: If the slot where you placed your action cube shows a card-to-food bonus conversion, you may discard at most 1 bird card from your hand to gain an additional food.

faq.question: Does the 'all dice show the same face' condition count as true if there's only 1 die left in the tray?
faq.answer: Yes. If all remaining dice in the tray show the same face—including if there is only 1 die—and you are about to gain food from the birdfeeder for any reason, you may first throw all 5 dice back into the birdfeeder.
faq.source_quote: If the dice in the tray all show the same face (including if there is only 1 die) and you are about to gain food from the birdfeeder for any reason, you may first throw all 5 dice back into the birdfeeder.

faq.question: The card says 'Gain 1 from the supply'—is that 1 food token or 1 egg token?
faq.answer: Most likely this refers to food tokens based on the context of similar birdfeeder-related effects, but the rulebook does not state this explicitly. Check the card's color or icon if available to confirm which type of token you gain.
faq.source_quote: 15cm WHEN ACTIVATED: Gain 1 from the supply.

faq.question: If two players tie for a position in scoring, do both of them get cubes on that place or does the second player get skipped?
faq.answer: Place all tied cubes on the same place, and do not award the next rank position to any other player. Both players occupy the tied position; the next available position is skipped.
faq.source_quote: If players tie, place both cubes on the tied place, and do not award the next place.
